item0.title: Community-driven data
item0.desc: Aggregates Chainabuse community reports so you know the real risk before you trade.

item1.title: Smart monitoring
item1.desc: Add an entity to your watchlist and we re-check it every 6 hours, alerting you to risk changes.

item2.title: Instant checks
item2.desc: Paste an address or URL and get a risk assessment with report details in milliseconds.

item3.title: Multi-chain support
item3.desc: Supports Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, Tron addresses and any website.
